rationale: The legal name describes a real estate development company ("Desenvolvimento Imobiliário"), which fits developers that build properties and sell them afterward, but web search failed and no primary source confirmed what the company actually does.

EPR Vias do Café is the Grupo EPR special-purpose concessionaire operating the Minas Gerais state toll-road concession (Lot 3, Varginha–Furnas: CMG-491, BR-146, CMG-369, LMG-863, BR-265, MG-167), a single-asset highway concession fitting Highways & Railtracks.
EPR Sul de Minas is the toll-road concessionaire running eight state highways (~454 km) in southern Minas Gerais, and its revenue comes from tolls, so it fits Highways & Railtracks.

Porto Saúde Participações is Porto's holding for its health vertical, controlling Porto Seguro Saúde. Most of its revenue comes from health insurance premiums and dental plans regulated by ANS (Brazil's health-plan regulator), with smaller occupational-health and care services, so it fits Managed Health Care rather than a services or facilities code.

Azevedo & Travassos Energia (AZTE3) produces onshore oil and gas in the Potiguar Basin through Phoenix Óleo e Gás and the Barrinha and Porto Carão hubs. Its revenue comes from upstream production and it has no refining or integrated operations, so it fits Oil & Gas Exploration & Production.

B100 S.A. (formerly CIABRASF / REAG Trust, now controlled by Planner's holding B100) earns fees mainly from administering investment funds (fiduciary administration, roughly R$370bn in funds), along with custody, bookkeeping, controllership and asset management, which fits Asset Management & Custody Banks.

Equipav Saneamento is a mono-holding whose results come mainly from consolidating its controlled subsidiary Aegea Saneamento e Participações, a water and sewage concession operator, so it is classified by that dominant business as a Water Utility.

REVEE S.A. (RVEE3) is a São Paulo holding whose filed activity is entertainment, event organization and shows through controlled companies (B3 segment: Produção de Eventos e Shows), which maps to live-entertainment within Movies & Entertainment; confidence is low because revenue data is thin and a March 2026 fact relevant announced acquisition of 'R. Real Estate', exit from Novo Mercado, renaming to REVEE MCO and later CVM registration cancellation (Nov 2026), so the dominant activity may have shifted. Second independent pass proposed 25301030 (Leisure Facilities).

The legal name ("Serviços Terapêuticos", meaning therapeutic services) and the CVM label ("Serviços Médicos", meaning medical services) both point to outpatient patient-care services, which best fits Health Care Services; no primary source confirmed this because web search was unavailable.

Atom Educação e Editora (ATED3), the Atom group's education arm, makes its money selling online trading and financial-market courses and teaching materials. It does not provide securities intermediation, which points to Education Services rather than Financials.

unclassified_reason: CVM lists the issuer as pre-operational (FASE PRÉ-OPERACIONAL). It is a holding company set up in October 2023 in São Paulo, and its CNPJ activity is the generic "holdings de instituições não-financeiras." No public source names an operating business or controlled subsidiary that would set its principal activity, so any sub-industry would be a guess.
rationale: This is a newly formed, pre-operational non-financial holding company with no identifiable operating business, so it cannot yet be given a GICS sub-industry.

Brisanet is a Northeast Brazil telecom operator. Most of its revenue comes from fiber-to-the-home broadband sold to end users, and it has a growing 4G/5G mobile business. A company that offers both fixed-line internet access and wireless service fits Integrated Telecommunication Services.

Automob (AMOB3), spun off from Vamos by Simpar, is a holding whose dominant business is a network of vehicle dealerships (cars, trucks, machinery and agricultural equipment), which fits Automotive Retail.

EPR Infraestrutura PR S.A. is a holding company (part of Grupo EPR, a Equipav/Perfin joint venture) whose only operating business is its subsidiary EPR Litoral Pioneiro, which runs the Lote 2 Paraná toll-road concession, so it falls under Highways & Railtracks.

EPR Litoral Pioneiro is the toll road concessionaire for Paraná's Lote 2 (Contract 02/2023, covering BR-277, PR-151, BR-369 and other roads, with eight toll plazas), so it fits Highways & Railtracks as a single-asset road concession.

company_name: CONCESSIONÁRIA DA LINHA 4 DO METRÔ DE SÃO PAULO S.A.
rationale: ViaQuatro (a Motiva/CCR subsidiary) holds the concession to run São Paulo Metro Line 4 (Yellow), and most of its revenue comes from passenger fares (tarifária), so it fits Rail Transportation, which covers passenger rail operators.

PRIO Forte S.A. (formerly OGX/Petro Rio Jaguar) is PRIO's main operating subsidiary, holding offshore oil field concessions (e.g., Frade, Wahoo) and listing crude oil and natural gas extraction as its principal activity, so it fits Oil & Gas Exploration & Production.

SPE Novo Norte Aeroportos is the concession company (Socicam/Dix consortium) that has held the federal ANAC concession since 2023 to expand, maintain and operate the Bloco Norte II airports (Belém and Macapá), which makes it an airport operator.

União Pet Participações (renamed from Cobasi Comércio de Produtos Básicos e Industrializados) is the holding of the combined Petz–Cobasi business. Its main activity is pet-supply specialty retail through stores and e-commerce, which fits Other Specialty Retail.

Sertrading is a foreign-trade trading company. Most of its revenue, booked as merchandise sales, comes from importing goods on behalf of third parties or to order, with export and import-consulting/BPO services on the side, so it fits Trading Companies & Distributors.

This special-purpose company (SPE) is Via Appia's 30-year ARTESP concession to finish building and then operate the tolled Rodoanel Norte highway in São Paulo; its first stretch opened to traffic with free-flow tolling in December 2025, so it belongs in Highways & Railtracks.

company_name: CONCESSIONARIA DAS RODOVIAS DO LESTE MS S/A
rationale: Way-112 is a single-asset toll road concessionaire that operates, maintains and expands 412.4 km of the MS-112, BR-158 and BR-436 highways in Mato Grosso do Sul, which places it in Highways & Railtracks.

company_name: TERP GLBL BRASIL I PARTICIPAÇÕES S.A.
rationale: TERP GLBL Brasil I is a holding company (Elera/Brookfield) that directly controls 14 wind power plants (the Alto Sertão I complex in Bahia), so its only operating business is renewable (wind) electricity generation.

Iguá Sergipe is the concession company (operating since May 2025) providing water distribution and sewage collection/treatment in 74 of Sergipe's 75 municipalities under a 35-year contract, a water utility activity.
Grupo Salta (formerly Eleva Educação) is a holding company. Its dominant business is running a network of about 170 private K-12 schools across Brazil, which places it in Education Services.

CPX Distribuidora is the main operating company of Grupo Cantu Store. As the Cantu Pneus brand, it imports and wholesales tyres, wheels and inner tubes to resellers. Its registered main activity is CNAE 4530-7/02, wholesale of tyres and inner tubes. It also runs the PneuStore e-commerce retail site, but wholesale auto-parts distribution looks like the principal activity, which fits Distributors.

company_name: TECNOGERA-LOCAÇÃO E TRANSFORMAÇÃO DE ENERGIA S.A.
rationale: Tecnogera rents out power generators, chillers and work-at-height equipment to businesses for temporary needs, and GICS places industrial machinery rental to other businesses in Trading Companies & Distributors.

Quantum Participações is a holding company. Its only business is controlling electricity transmission concessions (Sertaneja, Chimarrão, Mantiqueira and Pampa: about 2,851 km of lines and 33 substations), so it is classified by that transmission activity as an Electric Utility.
EPR Via Mineira is the Grupo EPR special-purpose concessionaire operating the federal BR-040 toll road concession in Minas Gerais, a single-asset toll road concession fitting Highways & Railtracks.

CSG holds the RS Parcerias Block 3 toll road concession and has operated about 270 km of state highways in the Serra Gaúcha and Vale do Caí since February 2023, which makes it a toll road owner-operator classified under Highways & Railtracks.

company_name: HIGHLINE BRASIL II INFRAESTRUTURA DE TELECOMUNICAÇÕES S.A.
rationale: Highline do Brasil II builds, owns and operates telecom towers and sites that it leases to mobile carriers across Brazil, and it raises debentures to build new towers. Brazilian companies cannot be REITs, and GICS puts companies that both construct and operate telecom towers in Integrated Telecommunication Services.

PRVias is a Motiva (formerly CCR) company holding the ANTT concession for Lot 3 of the Paraná integrated highways, about 569 km of toll roads that started operating in May 2025, so as a single-asset toll road operator it fits Highways & Railtracks.

OZN Health SPE (Opy Health – Delphina Aziz) is a single-asset special-purpose company that holds the PPP administrative concession for Hospital Delphina Aziz in Manaus. It provides infrastructure, equipment, clinical engineering and other non-clinical ("bata cinza") support services, such as cleaning, food, laundry, IT and security, to a public hospital whose clinical care is run by others. That fits Health Care Services, which covers business support services to health care providers, rather than Health Care Facilities.

OranjeBTC is a bitcoin treasury company. It listed on B3 through a reverse IPO of the Intergraus prep-school company, and its earnings and market perception are driven almost entirely by fair-value changes on about 3,700–3,950 BTC it holds for its own account; the education arm is small. So it is classified as a Financials investment vehicle under Asset Management & Custody Banks (closest fit for an investment-holding vehicle) rather than Education Services as the CVM label suggests. Second independent pass proposed 25302010 (Education Services).
EPR Iguaçu is the concessionaire of Lote 6 of the Paraná integrated highways (BR-277, BR-163 and state roads) under a 30-year toll road concession, which fits Highways & Railtracks.

company_name: VIA ARAUCÁRIA CONCESSIONÁRIA DE RODOVIAS S.A.
rationale: Via Araucária (Grupo Pátria) holds the 30-year ANTT concession for Lote 1 of the Paraná toll roads, covering about 473 km of BR-277, BR-373, BR-376, BR-476 and PR highways, and earns its revenue from toll road operation, so it fits Highways & Railtracks.

The company's name and its CVM label (electric-energy holding) suggest it holds renewable power generation assets, which would fit Renewable Electricity, but web search failed and no primary source confirmed its operating assets or revenue.

Mantiqueira Holding (formerly Quantum Mantiqueira Participações) is a holding company with one business: a 50% stake in Mantiqueira Transmissora de Energia S.A., which holds the ANEEL power transmission concession (12 lines in Minas Gerais), so as a single-industry holding it is classified as Electric Utilities (electricity transmission).

company_name: ÁGUAS DO PARÁ B SPE S.A.
rationale: Aegea-controlled SPE that holds the Block B water supply and sewage concession from the 2025 Pará state sanitation auction, so its activity is a regulated water and sewage utility.

company_name: ÁGUAS DO PARÁ A SPE S.A
rationale: Águas do Pará A SPE is Aegea's special-purpose concessionaire for Block A of Pará's water and sewage concession, which includes the Belém metropolitan region. It has run water supply and sewage services in Belém, Ananindeua and Marituba since September 2025, which makes it a Water Utility.

company_name: ÁGUAS DO PARÁ D SPE S.A.
rationale: Aegea-controlled SPE holding the 2025 concession contract for water supply and sewage services in Block D of the Pará Water and Sewage Microregion (MRAE), a single-asset sanitation concession that fits Water Utilities.

Platão Capital is a holding company (part of Platão Investimentos) that develops, owns and operates solar PV plants for distributed generation in PR, MS and MT, financed through infrastructure debentures. That is renewable power generation, so it fits Renewable Electricity.

company_name: COMPANHIA BRASILEIRA DE EDUCAÇÃO E SISTEMA DE ENSINO S.A.
rationale: CBE, based in Fortaleza, is an indirect wholly owned subsidiary of Arco Platform and the Brazilian operating and debenture-issuing entity of Arco's K-12 learning-systems and educational-content business, so it fits Education Services.

FGR Incorporações develops and sells residential gated-community projects (the 'Jardins' line, mainly urbanized lots, plus some houses) in Goiás and other states, which makes it a real estate developer that develops and sells property rather than a pure homebuilder.

company_name: PLAMEV ADMINISTRADORA DE BENEFÍCIOS DE ATENÇÃO À SAÚDE DE ANIMAIS DOMÉSTICOS S.A.
rationale: Plamev Pet sells pet health plans for dogs and cats. Customers pay monthly fees and the company covers vet care through its accredited network with no copayment, so it carries the claims risk; that matches pet insurance, which GICS places in Property & Casualty Insurance (the peer Trupanion is classified there), rather than Managed Health Care, which covers human health plans.

company_name: MAIS MU COMÉRCIO DE ALIMENTOS E BEBIDAS S/A.
rationale: Mais Mu develops and markets branded protein-based packaged foods (protein powders, snacks, bars, ready-to-drink beverages; 60+ SKUs sold in 11k+ points of sale), positioned as mainstream functional food rather than sports supplements, fitting Packaged Foods & Meats (supplement overlap with Personal Care noted).

VLI Multimodal is the holding that controls the rail freight concessions Ferrovia Centro-Atlântica and Ferrovia Norte-Sul, plus port and terminal operations. Most of its revenue comes from rail freight (measured in TKU on its network), so it fits Rail Transportation, even though the ports and terminals are a meaningful second segment.

EPR Paraná S.A. is a special-purpose toll-road company set up by the EPR group (EPR 2 Participações with Perfin). It most likely holds the concession for Lote 6 of the Paraná Integrated Highways (about 662 km of BR/PR roads), so it fits Highways & Railtracks as a single-asset road concession.

unclassified_reason: Web search hit its limit before I found any primary source (CVM filing, company IR, regulator) describing what Vellore S/A actually does. The only hint is the CVM sector label 'Comércio (Atacado e Varejo)'. It is too coarse to tell wholesale from retail or which merchandise is sold, and it could also describe a holding. I did not guess.
rationale: I could not confirm the company's main activity from evidence. The CVM label only points vaguely to trade, so it cannot be mapped to one GICS sub-industry. Second independent pass proposed 20107010 (Trading Companies & Distributors).

Brasil Terrenos is a Goiânia-based land developer (loteadora). It builds subdivisions and planned neighborhoods and sells the lots, with a land bank of 274 projects; selling land after developing it is real estate development, not homebuilding or construction.

Banco BV is a nationwide multiple bank (controlled by Votorantim and Banco do Brasil) that takes retail deposits and lends to retail customers (about 75% of its loan book, mostly used-car finance) and to companies (about 25%), and it also does corporate/investment banking and asset management, so Diversified Banks fits better than Consumer Finance despite the heavy auto-loan concentration.
